---
title: "Backend Support Matrix"
---

No backend is implemented in Phase 1. The table is a roadmap, not a capability
claim.

| Backend surface | Public namespace | Phase-1 state | Planned order |
|---|---|---|---|
| Palace Electrostatic | `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented | Near term, with Surface EPR emphasis |
| Palace Eigenmode | `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented | Near term |
| Palace Driven | `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented | Later |
| Palace Magnetostatic | `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented | Later |
| HFSS Eigenmode | `scgsim.aedt` | Planned; not implemented | Near term |
| HFSS Driven Modal | `scgsim.aedt` | Planned; not implemented | Near term |
| HFSS Driven Terminal | `scgsim.aedt` | Planned; not implemented | Near term |
| Q3D | `scgsim.aedt` | Planned; not implemented | Near term |
| Q2D | `scgsim.aedt` | Planned; not implemented | Near term |
| Meep | None | Excluded | Not planned |

Backend support requires real implementation, validation, and evidence. A
namespace name or source-lane identity is not support.
